Bill.BriefDescription: Specifying procedures for adverse possession actions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adverse possession; adding new sections tochapter 7.28 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In an action involving a claim asserting title to real propertyby adverse possession, the person asserting the claim must prove eachelement of the claim by clear and convincing evidence. (2) In an action involving a claim asserting title to real propertyby adverse possession, the person asserting the claim of adversepossession is liable for the costs and reasonable attorneys' fees ofthe party defending against the claim of adverse possession. (3) This section does not apply to claims of adverse possessionbrought under RCW 7.28.050, 7.28.070, or 7.28.085.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The prevailing party in an action involving a claim of adversepossession of real property is liable for any taxes levied on the real p. 1 HB 1026property during the period of adverse possession that were paid byanother party or that are owed to the county assessor of the county inwhich the real property is located.
This act applies to actions filed on orafter July 1, 2012.
